name: Image Glitch
description: Canvas image centered on the screen that continuously corrupts with horizontal glitch lines, sliding bands, RGB channel shifts and scattered displaced fragments.
contents: Full-screen canvas rendering one image with live glitch effects
behavior: Redraws every animation frame with random scan line, band shift, RGB split and scattered fragment glitches
Randomly pauses the glitch to show the clean image for short moments
editableByProps: Number of scan lines, shifted bands and scattered fragments

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the canvas fill color behind the image
needsCodeEdit.where: ctx.fillStyle line inside the tick function
range constant inside the shiftRGB function

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Image must allow cross-origin pixel access (CORS) so the canvas can read it
Canvas is sized to the window and the image is drawn at natural size, so images larger than the screen are cropped
